title: PlayerCore: Troubleshooting
summary: Resolve command-disabled messages, unsafe destinations, cooldowns, missing homes, and permission blocks.

blocks.title: Command Disabled
blocks.body: If a command reports disabled, the server config likely turned off that feature. Use the allowed travel surface or ask an admin before planning around it.

blocks.title: Destination Failed
blocks.body: Unsafe destinations, blocked dimensions, missing homes, missing warps, and cross-dimension restrictions are different problems. Read the message before retrying.

blocks.title: Cooldown Or Permission
blocks.body: Cooldowns protect server pacing. Permission checks protect shared travel surfaces such as admin warps. Wait, choose another route, or ask for the appropriate access.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
